explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of truth and does not lie, according to Titus 1.
The divine word that stands firm regardless of human deceit or change.
Never saying anything untrue; a characteristic God has given His servants to imitate.
To take care of God's house and be a good example in speech, conduct, and teaching.
Necessary so that no one can blame us or speak ill of the gospel.
Departure from the true faith often caused by false teachers with impure motives.
Something deceitful that does not align with God's word, especially regarding doctrine.
To be sanctified by God through his grace and to live a life of purity.
An attitude where one honors God by following his commands and avoiding sin.
The true faith that is to be passed on to the older men so that they can teach others.
